plain_text:
Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Willard Waterman is credited on 225 distinct recordings across 10 programs from 1947-06-02 through 1957-04-16. Documented roles include performer on 225 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are The Great Gildersleeve (performer on 178 recordings; 178 distinct recordings), The Whistler (performer on 13 recordings; 13 distinct recordings), The Halls of Ivy (performer on 10 recordings; 10 distinct recordings), Lux Radio Theatre (performer on 8 recordings; 8 distinct recordings), Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar (performer on 7 recordings; 7 distinct recordings), Screen Directors Playhouse (performer on 4 recordings; 4 distinct recordings), Father Knows Best (performer on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings), and Escape (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording).

Documented character portrayals include Throckmorton P. Gildersleeve (178 portrayals).
